evidence_items.summary: Supplementary Figure S1 text describes an apoptotic profile assay for untreated Candida albicans cells and cells treated with K13L for 30 min; no tabulated quadrant percentages were present in local extracted text.

unrecoverable_material_gaps.why_unrecoverable: The local supplementary PDF contains Figure S1 explanatory text only in extracted text and no table of quadrant percentages or raw apoptotic profile values.
unrecoverable_material_gaps.impact: Final mechanism records use the supplement only as qualitative context and do not fabricate exact apoptosis quadrant values.
